Ariadne by Switzerland Omics provides licensed access to a large, curated collection of biological data for AI and computational research.  

The library brings together high-value scientific datasets with documented provenance, licensing, scientific context and machine-readable metadata. Customers can explore the collection through a human catalogue or connect computational systems directly to the same catalogue and underlying data.  

Instead of repeatedly discovering, reviewing, downloading and organising heterogeneous biological resources internally, teams receive a maintained data environment that can be used for model training, retrieval, benchmarking, drug discovery and computational experiments.  

A 30 TB Ariadne deployment can be mounted read-only inside a customer's research environment. AI systems can query the catalogue, identify relevant datasets, inspect their structure and provenance, and access only the underlying files required for a particular task.
